name: OnceHub
description: OnceHub lets authenticated users manage their own meetings, booking calendars and hubs, booking links, and recurring or date-specific availability through Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OnceHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OnceHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my-mcp.oncehub.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OnceHub MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OnceHub provides these MCP tools: cancel_meeting, get_booking_link, get_my_booking_calendars, get_my_booking_hubs, get_my_upcoming_meetings, get_my_working_hours, get_one_time_use_link, manage_my_pending_meeting_requests, mark_meeting_no_show, request_guest_to_reschedule, update_my_date_specific_availability, and update_my_recurring_working_hours.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OnceHub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OnceHub in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
OnceHub requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OnceHub is developed by OnceHub. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
